collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SLS 2010 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz SLS 2010 - 2014 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20 for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
